name: Kozicare Skin Lightening Non-Sticky Cream 15gm | Enriched with 3% Kojic Acid, 1% Alpha Arbutin, 1% Glutathione, 2% Niacinamide, 2% Vitamin C | Best for Melasma, Pigmentation, Dark/Age Spots, Uneven Sk
description:
Kozicare Skin Lightening Cream Lotion – 15gm
🌸 Advanced Formula for Bright, Even & Healthy Skin

Key Benefits:

Fades dark spots, melasma, pigmentation & acne scars

Provides sun protection while reducing age spots

Encourages firmer, youthful-looking skin

Deeply hydrates & nourishes the skin

Reduces fine lines & wrinkles

Suitable for all skin types & tones

Powerful 7-in-1 Formula:
✔ 3% Kojic Acid – Targets pigmentation & brightens
✔ 1% Glutathione – Improves complexion & reduces oxidative stress
✔ 1% Alpha Arbutin – Lightens stubborn dark spots
✔ 2% Niacinamide – Strengthens skin barrier & improves elasticity
✔ 2% Vitamin C – Fights free radicals & boosts glow
✔ 2% Mulberry Extract – Natural skin brightener
✔ 0.5% Liquorice – Soothes and evens skin tone

Why Choose Kozicare?
✨ Tried & trusted by 500,000+ happy customers
✨ Dermatologist-recommended safe & effective formula
✨ Can be used all over the body (underarms, knees, elbows, neck, private areas)

Best For:

Hyperpigmentation

Melasma & discoloration

Dark/age spots

Uneven skin shade

Sun-damaged skin
